it.polimi.ingsw.am02.common.messages.events.game.GameSetupCompletedEvent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Event, GameEvent, Message, Serializable
public record GameSetupCompletedEvent(Map<String,Totem> totemByPlayer, List<String> turnOrder, Map<String,Integer> initialFood, BoardSnapshot boardSnapshot) extends Record implements GameEvent
Notifies all players of the initial board and player setup at game start.
